arrival_hub.accountHint: Sameyso akoon si aad uga qayb qaadato. Waxaad dhex geli kartaa goobaha oo aad sahamin kartaa doorarka ka hor inta aadan ku soo biirin.

arrival_hub.communityHint: Wada hadallo dadweyne, qolal toos ah, iyo fariimo gaar ah.
arrival_hub.economyHint: Raadi shaqo, kala wedaarsado badeecadaha iyo adeegyada, oo maamul boorsadaada.
arrival_hub.everyday: Ka qayb qaado nolosha maalin laha ah

arrival_hub.intro: Sahami adduun lagu dayanayay, raac go'aannada dadweyne, oo ogaado sida doorarka madaniga ah u shaqeeyaan.
arrival_hub.learnHint: Raac safar hage leh, akhri cashar, ama daawo muuqaal.
arrival_hub.placesHint: Dhex gal geedka xuduud awoodeed laga bilaabo adduunka ilaa bulshooyinka maxaliga ah. Fur goob si aad u hesho dawladdeeda iyo khariidadaha degmo doorashada sharci-dejinta.
arrival_hub.returnHint: Raadi dhacdooyinkaaga soo socda iyo dhaqdhaqaaqaaga madaniga ah ee hadda.
arrival_hub.rolesHint: Arag shaqada degane, xubin golaha sharci-dejinta, garsoore, guddoomiye guddi, xubin guddiga maamulka doorashada, ama maamulaha nidaamka.
